notes: The film's route (S5, the user's grand tour): west → east from Hobbiton to Mount Doom, loosely following Frodo's road but detouring through Rohan (Fangorn, Isengard, Helm's Deep, Edoras) to pass the landmarks the world has built. Legs follow valleys, passes and the foot of mountains (the exaggerated relief turns a leg over a range into a plumb line on screen): Hollin round the west end of the Sirannon spur (no Caradhras summit), Isengard passed at the mouth of Nan Curunir, Rivendell at the open (west) end of its gorge, Henneth Annûn on the open side of its alcove, Helm's Deep passed at the mouth of its coomb, the plains along the White Mountains' foot to Edoras, the Black Gate left westward round the north end of the Ephel Dúath into Ithilien, Mount Doom climbed on the south-east face the hold camera sees (between the lava flows at 104° and 166°) to the crater rim. Spatial only — timing lives in timeline.json. Points: {place} = places.json display position (+ optional offsetKm [east, north]) or {at: [x, y]} ME-GIS km. Legs chain (a leg starts where the previous one ends). Modes: foot (smooth curve draped on the ground), boat (river centreline `river` / lake `lake` at the water level), underground (Moria: dotted and dim). Compiled by src/tour/route.ts.

legs.note: over the Trollshaws and the high ground north-west of the Bruinen, across its valley and up the north side of the floor of the Rivendell gorge (the head rests 0.6 km short of the display point, in the hold's frame; the label's anchor sits on the house)

round a 0.7 km turn and back down the south side of the gorge floor (the gorge is a dead end: the way out runs 1.4 km beside the way in) and south-west to the Bruinen at the Ford (a U round the gorge mouth with the arrival 5–8 km to the north, no climb over the gorge's south rim), south down its valley, then south-west along the western foot of the Misty Mountains (Hollin), over the low west end of the spur north of the Sirannon (km 797, crest ≈ 13 vs ≈ 25 where the old leg crossed), down to the Sirannon and up the gentle south-west shoulder of the gate terrace (its north-west edge is a 5 km step) to the West-gate

the Rohan detour: Lórien → Fangorn → down to the plain and west to the mouth of Nan Curunir (the head rests there, 9 km south of Orthanc: the ring basin is walled on three sides — a leg into it and out again would hook)

south down the Isen's east bank, up the west side of the mouth of the Deeping-coomb (seen end-on from the hold camera) onto its level floor; the head rests 4 km short of the Hornburg (the diamond stays on the keep)
out of the coomb down its eastern flank (a U with the way in, 5–7 km apart), then east along the plain at the foot of the White Mountains
north-east over the plains to the Anduin above the Argonath

east from the falls along the low ground under the southern Emyn Muil (no Λ back north into the hills, no climb onto their block), across the Dead Marshes, past the north (near) side of the basalt butte in front of the Gate (not over it) to the Gate

the Gate shut: west along its front, round the north end of the Ephel Dúath and south along its western foot through Ithilien, past the open (west) side of the Henneth Annûn alcove (the head rests 3 km west of the pool: the scarp's arms wall it on the north, east and south)

across Gorgoroth south of the cone, round its southern foot to the east and up the south-east face (between the flows at 104° and 166°) in one switchback: east along the foot, then a rising traverse back right to left as the hold camera sees it (≈ 40° on screen, no straight climb up the flank) to the crater rim
